Haven't been posting for quite sometime... I now minimise my pairs to Gold and Euro due to my busy life...The post here is not to boast my winning trades. But to look at my emo entries which turns out to be losers or breakeven... Euro...I got the best price of sell 1.2576..Closed 2/3 of the trade and trailing the remaining...

Gold....My first loss is due to tinking the QM sell base there...Instead it went higher and i had fear entering until i missed it.Then i entered at the pullback or retest of the broken support...Due to some fear, i took profits early.Followed by another loser until its too late when i start to see the potential RBD sell zone and entered short there... Trailing as usual as i have no time to babysit the trade...
